name: interactive-grid-pattern
title: Interactive Grid Pattern
description: An SVG grid of small square cells that fills the one you hover with a soft grey wash, then fades it out slowly, leaving a short trail as the pointer moves.
use: A dark hero or section needs a quiet technical texture that answers the cursor.
avoid: Bright screens: the grid is so low-contrast it nearly vanishes.
a11y: Hover only: cells cannot be highlighted from the keyboard, and the grid carries no text or labels. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark field of small square cells outlined in faint grey, tiled evenly across the stage. A radial fade darkens the edges so the grid reads most clearly near the centre.
behaves: Squares under the pointer light up almost at once, then fade back over about a second while the cursor moves on, which leaves a brief diagonal trail of lit cells.
customise: Cell size and grid count are props, and classes on the cells let you recolour the stroke and hover fill.
weight: light: An SVG of a few hundred rectangles with CSS fill transitions; idle until hover.
issues: The grid is so low-contrast it almost disappears on dark screens.
polishWhy: Clean even grid and a subtle hover wash, but the contrast is too faint to read.
